purpose: Deterministically reproduce the retained M10J_C0212 M15 SHORT candidate from frozen raw GOLD CSVs before any separate fresh prospective C0212 shadow is designed.

candidate.entry: Exact M1 open bid at the causal M15 decision timestamp.
candidate.exit: Exact M1 open ask 240 minutes later, using exit spread_points * point. No nearest-M1 fallback.

causal_feature_contract.m15_decision: For fully closed M15 bar i, decision is M15 bar i+1 open time.
causal_feature_contract.h1_context: Latest H1 bar fully closed at or before M15 decision.
causal_feature_contract.h4_context: Latest H4 bar fully closed at or before M15 decision.
causal_feature_contract.h4_ema20_30_bps: (H4 EMA20 - H4 EMA30) / abs(latest fully closed H4 close) * 10000.
causal_feature_contract.h1_atr_pct100: Percentile rank of latest fully closed H1 Wilder ATR14 inside the trailing 100 H1 ATR values, inclusive.

reference.source: M10J C0212 with exact formula independently rediscovered by M10M_H240_C006

decision_after_run.if_pass: Keep C0212 frozen and design a separate fresh prospective C0212 audit-only shadow with its own new immutable MT5-server start, never reusing M10P start.
decision_after_run.if_mismatch: Do not start a C0212 fresh shadow. Diagnose the reproduction mismatch without changing C0212 thresholds or any running forward monitor.
